units.title: 羽毛球社的借用与等候

materials.title: Badminton Club Turns 035A
materials.text: At badminton club, borrow a racket at the front desk. Wait outside the playing court until called. Return the shuttle before borrowing another. Put a racket with a loose string on the repair shelf. At the end, return every borrowed racket to the desk.

questions.prompt: Your friend wants a racket but cannot find one. Say: ____
questions.explanation: A前台借拍对应无拍；B水龙头、C分卡不提供借用处。

questions.prompt: A friend steps onto the court before being called. Say: ____
options: Wait outside until you are called.
Put your bottle in your bag.
questions.explanation: B未叫名前场外等，直接纠位置时机；A换拍、C收瓶不解决提前入场。

questions.prompt: Your friend asks for another shuttle while keeping the first. Say: ____
options: Return the first shuttle before borrowing another.
questions.explanation: C先还再借规则；A保两只违条件；B结束时间不答借还。

questions.prompt: A racket has a loose string. Your friend asks what to do. Say: ____
options: Put it on the repair shelf.
Use it for the next game.
Return it as if nothing is wrong.
questions.explanation: A松线拍待修架；B再用、C隐故障回台不合分流。

questions.prompt: Club time is over. A friend keeps a borrowed racket. Say: ____
options: Keep it for tomorrow without asking.
Return it to the front desk.
questions.explanation: B结束借拍全回前台；A未经许可留用、C场外散放非交还。

units.title: 试眼镜时说清楚感受

materials.title: Glasses Shop Needs 035A
materials.text: A child is choosing glasses with a parent. Choose the sentence that meets the stated communication need.

questions.prompt: The letters on a line look blurred to you. You need to tell the helper. What do you say?
options: I cannot read that line clearly.
questions.explanation: A报告该行看不清；B框色、C眼镜盒不说明阅读感受。

questions.prompt: The frames press your nose and feel too tight. What do you say?
options: These feel too tight on my nose.
questions.explanation: B明确鼻部太紧不适；A擦镜、C收据位置不报告贴合问题。

questions.prompt: You want a case to protect the glasses in your bag. What do you ask?
options: May I have a case for the glasses?
questions.explanation: C请求保护眼镜盒；A关门时、B换色不提供防护容器。

questions.prompt: You want Mum to see the frames before you choose. What do you ask?
options: May I show these frames to Mum first?
May I pay before trying them?
May I put the old pair in its case?
questions.explanation: A先给母亲看符合共同选定需求；B先付、C收旧镜不获取母亲意见。

questions.prompt: You need a place for your old glasses while trying the new ones. What do you ask?
options: Where may I put my old glasses while I try these?
Can you tell me the price again?
questions.explanation: B问旧镜暂存处；A再读、C再报价不解决现有物品位置。

units.title: 水族馆参观日的十段完整句子

materials.title: Aquarium Day Ten Sentences 035A
materials.text: Choose the word or reply fitting each complete aquarium-day situation.

questions.prompt: Our guide ____ explaining the sea-turtle display now.
questions.explanation: A guide单数is加explaining表正在；B am配I；C be原形不作当前谓语。

questions.prompt: The fish are behind the glass. We must not tap on ____.
questions.explanation: B it指glass作on宾语；A they主格且指鱼非玻璃，C its物主不能独立作此宾语。

questions.prompt: The coats belong to the two helpers. They are ____ coats.
questions.explanation: C two helpers复数their；A/B单个人称物主不合。

questions.prompt: Please ____ on the dry path, not on the wet stones.
questions.explanation: A祈使walk原形；B单三、C分词不构成所需指令。

questions.prompt: The little child cannot see the label. Could you read it ____?
questions.explanation: B aloud朗读帮助获取内容；A圆、C渴不描述读法。

questions.prompt: There are three ____ in this small display tank.
questions.explanation: C three需crabs标准复数；A单数；B错拼。

questions.prompt: Does this fish live in fresh water? Yes, it ____.
questions.explanation: A Does问用does答；B不配it；C are不答此live助动词问题。

questions.prompt: The room is dark so the display is easy to see. Keep your phone light ____.
questions.explanation: B off保持暗环境；A开灯、C高亮方向都不配所述暗室目的。

questions.prompt: ____ can answer our question? The guide near the turtle tank.
questions.explanation: C人员答Who；A地点、B时间不对应。

questions.prompt: We have finished the visit. Let us ____ the borrowed map to the desk.
questions.explanation: A let us后return原形；B单三、C分词不合。

units.title: 早餐社里的五个具体回答

materials.title: Breakfast Club Replies 035A
materials.text:
Match each question with the reply that fits it. Use each reply once.
A. Because the cups are still being washed.
B. The helper checking the meal list.
C. After our whole table has been served.
D. Yes, if you use the clean spoon.
E. In the container marked for food scraps.

questions.prompt: Why must we wait for more cups?
options: Because the cups are still being washed.
The helper checking the meal list.
After our whole table has been served.
Yes, if you use the clean spoon.
In the container marked for food scraps.
questions.explanation: A杯仍在洗解释等候；B查餐人、C整桌供齐时、D净勺许可、E残渣处非杯子原因。

questions.prompt: Who can check whether my breakfast order is ready?
options: Because the cups are still being washed.
The helper checking the meal list.
After our whole table has been served.
Yes, if you use the clean spoon.
In the container marked for food scraps.
questions.explanation: B查餐单帮手答核单人员；A原因、C时机、D条件、E位置不答Who。

questions.prompt: When should our table start eating together?
options: Because the cups are still being washed.
The helper checking the meal list.
After our whole table has been served.
Yes, if you use the clean spoon.
In the container marked for food scraps.
questions.explanation: C全桌供齐后答共食时机；A杯因、B人、D净勺、E残渣箱均不答When。

questions.prompt: May I take some yogurt from the large bowl?
options: Because the cups are still being washed.
The helper checking the meal list.
After our whole table has been served.
Yes, if you use the clean spoon.
In the container marked for food scraps.
questions.explanation: D可但用净勺，答取食许可条件；A原因、B人、C整桌时、E残渣处不答器具要求。

questions.prompt: Where do the banana peels go after breakfast?
options: Because the cups are still being washed.
The helper checking the meal list.
After our whole table has been served.
Yes, if you use the clean spoon.
In the container marked for food scraps.
questions.explanation: E食物残渣标容器对应果皮；A洗杯、B人、C时机、D净勺不答废物位置。

units.title: 海报社需要的五个问句开头

materials.title: Poster Club Question Bank 035A
materials.text:
Use each shared bank phrase once to complete all five short conversations. Bank: A. When B. Whose C. How many D. Who E. Where
1. ____1____ designed this poster? Nina did.
2. ____2____ crayons are these? They are Tom’s.
3. ____3____ should we hang the finished poster? Beside the hall door.
4. ____4____ will the display open? On Thursday morning.
5. ____5____ title cards do we need? Twelve.

questions.prompt: Which phrase completes gap 1?
questions.explanation: D Who问设计者，对Nina did；A When时间、B Whose所有者、C How many数量、E Where位置均不答谁设计。

questions.prompt: Which phrase completes gap 2?
questions.explanation: B Whose问crayons物主，对Tom’s；A时间、C数量、D人作主语、E地点均不构成所需物主疑问。

questions.prompt: Which phrase completes gap 3?
questions.explanation: E Where问挂处，对hall door旁；A时间、B所有者、C数量、D人物均不答放置地点。

questions.prompt: Which phrase completes gap 4?
questions.explanation: A When问开幕时机，对Thursday morning；B物主、C数量、D人物、E地点不对应时间。

questions.prompt: Which phrase completes gap 5?
questions.explanation: C How many后可数复数cards，对Twelve；A时间、B物主、D人物、E地点均非数量问法。

units.title: 摸一摸盒子里的东西

materials.title: Mystery Box Pebble Story 035A
materials.text: Our teacher puts a safe object in a cloth bag. We may feel it but not look inside at first. Dan says it is smooth and cold, so he guesses a coin. Eva feels it too and says it is much thicker than a coin. The teacher asks them to use all the clues. Then she opens the bag. It is a small round pebble. Dan laughs and says one clue can fit many things. We write the words smooth, cold and thick in our word books.

questions.prompt: What may pupils do at first?
options: Feel the object without seeing it.
Throw the object across the room.
questions.explanation: A先可摸不看；B立即开违阶段；C扔物未获许可。

questions.prompt: What does Dan first guess?
questions.explanation: B smooth cold让他猜coin；A纸卡、C长绳非所猜。

questions.prompt: What extra clue does Eva give?
options: It is louder than a bell.
It is thicker than a coin.
questions.explanation: C补厚度反证硬币；A音响、B字名无据。

questions.prompt: What is actually in the bag?
questions.explanation: A开袋小圆卵石；B玩鱼、C金属勺均非揭晓物。

questions.prompt: What does Dan learn?
options: Several clues are more useful than one clue alone.
questions.explanation: B单线索可合多物，需综合；A初猜正被否定；C后来允许开袋。

units.title: 开始游戏前先约定哪套规则

materials.title: Home Game Rules Eight Cloze 035A
materials.text:
Read the complete story and choose the word for every numbered gap.
At Yuni’s house, we played a game I knew from school. Her family used a ____1____ way to start, and I wanted to ____2____ that they were wrong. We read the game card. It allowed players to choose a starting rule ____3____ the first round. We had not ____4____ on one together. We stopped and chose the ____5____ rule for everyone. Then we began again. Changing a rule halfway through would be unfair ____6____ some players had already made choices under the old one. We wrote our chosen version ____7____ on a card. The game felt ____8____ when everybody knew what to expect.

questions.prompt: Which word completes gap 1?
questions.explanation: A different与我学校已知玩法不同相应；B睡着、C木制不修饰启动规则差异。

questions.prompt: Which word completes gap 2?
questions.explanation: B argue that争称别人错；A烹饪、C测量不接该争论内容。

questions.prompt: Which word completes gap 3?
questions.explanation: C首轮前选规则；A下方、B后方不连接轮次开始时机。

questions.prompt: Which word completes gap 4?
questions.explanation: A agreed on one共同同意某版；B印、C睡不构成该约定关系。

questions.prompt: Which word completes gap 5?
questions.explanation: B全体同一规则确保预期；A重、C饿不表规则一致。

questions.prompt: Which word completes gap 6?
questions.explanation: C他人已据旧规作选择是中途改不公原因；A选择、B除非条件不表达既成因果。

questions.prompt: Which word completes gap 7?
questions.explanation: A清楚写供所有人读；B吵写、C水下不实现可明白约定。

questions.prompt: Which word completes gap 8?
questions.explanation: B所有人预期一致更公平fairer；A更高、C更圆不评价游戏公平性。

units.title: 诗歌投稿纸上的编号

materials.title: Poetry Entry Notice 035A
materials.text:
Poetry display notice
Submit one original poem of no more than twelve lines by Friday afternoon. Pictures are welcome but will not be part of the judging. Put your name and class on a separate slip inside the envelope. Do not write them on the poem itself. Helpers will give each entry a number so judges can read without seeing the writer’s identity. After judging, selected poems may be read aloud at assembly, but the teacher will ask each writer first. Entering the display does not require agreeing to a public reading.

questions.prompt: Each pupil may submit several poems for the same entry.
questions.explanation: B正确：one original poem；A多篇超投稿数量。

questions.prompt: Pictures may be included, but they are not judged.
questions.explanation: A正确：welcome but not judging；B混淆可附与评选内容。

questions.prompt: The poem sheet itself should show the writer’s full name.
questions.explanation: B正确：名班另纸封内，诗本页不写；A把身份位置放错。

questions.prompt: Entry numbers help judges read without the writer’s identity.
questions.explanation: A正确：give number sojudges withoutidentity；B否认编号目的。

questions.prompt: Permission for public reading is separate from entering the display.
questions.explanation: A正确：先问作者，入展不强制公开读；B把两种同意合并。

units.title: 社区参观记录的词形

materials.title: Community Visit Forms 035A
materials.text:
Complete all five gaps using the correct one-word form of each given word.
1. Yesterday, we ____1____ (hear) a short talk about the old railway.
2. Two ____2____ (child) helped carry the lightweight display cards.
3. This paper is ____3____ (thin) than the card used for the title.
4. Look! The helper is ____4____ (write) the next group’s number on the board.
5. We handled the borrowed map ____5____ (careful; use the conventional adverb ending in -ly).

questions.prompt: Gap 1: use HEAR.
questions.explanation: 接受heard：Yesterday过去，hear不规则；hear原形、heared错、hearing分词非过去谓语。

questions.prompt: Gap 2: use CHILD.
questions.explanation: 接受children：Two明确复数，child不规则；child单数、childs错、childrens重复复数不合。

questions.prompt: Gap 3: use THIN.
questions.explanation: 接受thinner：than比较厚薄，thin双写n加er；thin原级、thinest拼写非该比较级、thinness名词均不合。

questions.prompt: Gap 4: use WRITE.
questions.explanation: 接受writing：is进行，write去e加ing；write原形、writeing错拼、wrote过去式不合正在写。

questions.prompt: Gap 5: write the conventional adverb ending in -ly from CAREFUL.
questions.explanation: 接受carefully：本空明示CAREFUL常规-ly副词。careful、carefuller、carefulness不满足本空形态要求；不据此概括其他语境的合法性，未列形式复核。

units.title: 和邻居约定帮忙时怎么说

materials.title: Neighbour Arrangement Functions 035A
materials.text: Choose the sentence that directly achieves the stated purpose. Other options are reasonable requests with different goals.

questions.prompt: A neighbour works at night. You need to agree on a suitable time to bring a parcel. What should you ask?
options: What time would be convenient for me to bring the parcel?
Where can I buy wrapping paper?
questions.explanation: A询对方合适接件时间，照顾作息；B重量、C包装购买不安排时间。

questions.prompt: You can help in the afternoon but not the requested morning. You want to offer an alternative. What should you say?
options: Please tell me the street name.
I cannot come in the morning, but I could help after two. Would that work?
May I borrow a bigger bag?
questions.explanation: B说明限制并提下午替代求同意；A路名、C借袋不协商时段。

questions.prompt: A neighbour asks to borrow an item that belongs to your sister. You need the owner’s permission first. What should you say?
options: I can lend anything in the house.
It belongs to my sister, so I need to ask her before lending it.
questions.explanation: C说明物主与先征许可；A过度授权；B商店时与物主同意无关。

questions.prompt: Rain has changed a shared gardening plan. You want everyone to know the new meeting point. What should you say?
options: Shall we confirm the new meeting point with everyone before we leave?
How many plants are in your garden?
May I keep this watering can?
questions.explanation: A离前向全员确认新点，符合共同变更沟通；B植数、C借壶不传达集合变更。

questions.prompt: The address you heard includes an unclear house number. You want to check the exact number. What should you ask?
options: Would you like a different parcel box?
Could you repeat the house number so I can write it correctly?
When did the street get its name?
questions.explanation: B重说门牌供准确记录；A换盒、C街名史不核当前地址。

units.title: 轮滑课装备与场地的安排

materials.title: Skating Class Equipment 035B
materials.text: At skating class, the helper checks helmets before children start. Wait on the rubber mat while your skates are fitted. Keep away from the road. A raised red paddle means stop. Return borrowed knee pads to the large basket after class.

questions.prompt: A friend starts before the helmet check. Say: ____
options: Ask the helper to check your helmet first.
questions.explanation: A先核头盔对应开动条件；B水瓶、C车站不解决未检装备。

questions.prompt: A friend waits on the open skating path while fitting skates. Say: ____
questions.explanation: B装鞋时橡胶垫等；A占运动线、C未开始即还护具不对应等待位置。

questions.prompt: A friend rolls towards the road. Say: ____
questions.explanation: C远道路直接纠路线；A换帽、B喝水不能授权靠路。

questions.prompt: The helper raises the red paddle. Say: ____
options: Stop; that is the stop signal.
questions.explanation: A红拍表示停止；B竞赛、C靠路与信号相反。

questions.prompt: Class ends. A friend leaves borrowed knee pads on the ground. Say: ____
options: Leave them for the next child.
Put them in the large basket.
Keep them in your bag without asking.
questions.explanation: B结束借护膝回大篮；A地留、C私留不归位。

units.title: 帮家人洗衣前后怎么问

materials.title: Laundry Help Needs 035B
materials.text: Choose the sentence that meets the exact need while helping a parent with laundry.

questions.prompt: You find coins in a shirt pocket and need to know where to leave them. Ask: ____
options: Where should I put these coins from the pocket?
questions.explanation: A问口袋取币的保管处；B衣龄、C买衣不处理发现物。

questions.prompt: The wool scarf label says hand wash. Your friend starts putting it in the machine. Say: ____
options: Let us ask Dad; this label says hand wash.
Put all the dry socks away first.
questions.explanation: B据手洗标签先求成人核对；A乱按、C收袜不处理当前清洗方式。

questions.prompt: A wet shirt is ready to hang. You need a hanger. Ask: ____
options: May I have the shoe box?
May I have a shopping list?
May I have a hanger for this wet shirt?
questions.explanation: C索衣架晾湿衫；A鞋盒、B清单均非晾衣工具。

questions.prompt: Two dry socks look alike, and you want to know if they are a pair. Ask: ____
options: Do these two socks go together?
questions.explanation: A确认配对；B水温、C洗衣粉位置不辨干袜组合。

questions.prompt: The parent is folding clothes, and you want to help with a suitable job. Say: ____
options: Shall I put the dry towels on the shelf?
Can I wet the folded clothes again?
questions.explanation: B提出收干毛巾的合理分工；A改标签、C重新打湿不帮收尾。

units.title: 面包房参观的十段完整句子

materials.title: Bakery Visit Ten Choices 035B
materials.text: Choose the word or reply fitting each full bakery-visit situation.

questions.prompt: The baker puts the bread ____ the oven to bake it.
questions.explanation: A in oven在炉内烤；B横过、C之前不能作此处烘烤空间关系。

questions.prompt: The bread is for our class. These are ____ rolls.
questions.explanation: B our class共同物主our；A/C单个人物所有不符。

questions.prompt: The paper bags ____ on a clean stand near the counter.
questions.explanation: C bags复数are；A is单数、B am配I不合。

questions.prompt: Please ____ the warm tray with the adult helper, not alone.
questions.explanation: A祈使carry原形；B单三、C分词不构成该指令。

questions.prompt: Does this bun have seeds on top? No, it ____.
questions.explanation: B Does否定回答does not；A do肯定且不配it；C are not不配单数也不答have。

questions.prompt: We buy three small ____ to share after the visit.
questions.explanation: C three要求rolls标准复数；A单数，B错加es。

questions.prompt: The helper shows me the label. I read ____ before choosing.
questions.explanation: A read后宾格it指标签；B its物主、C反身自身不合本句主宾关系。

questions.prompt: ____ are the spare paper bags? Under the counter.
questions.explanation: B counter下答地点Where；A时间、C人员不对应。

questions.prompt: Would you like a plain bun? Yes, ____.
questions.explanation: C Yes please接受邀请；A门身份、B架下位置不回应食物邀请。

questions.prompt: This bread feels ____ when I gently press it. It is easy to break into pieces.
questions.explanation: A soft柔软触感；B响为声音、C晚为时间，不描述本句手感。

units.title: 买三明治时改用自己的餐盒

materials.title: Sandwich Lunchbox Order 035B
materials.text:
Order the dialogue. The first line is fixed: 1. Does this sandwich have cheese?
A. Here is an egg sandwich without cheese. Would you like a bag?
B. No, thank you. I have a lunch box.
C. Yes, it does. Do you need one without cheese?
D. All right. I will put it in your lunch box.
E. Yes, please. I will choose the egg one.
Choose each line’s position from 2 to 6.

questions.prompt: What position does line A take?
questions.explanation: C第4步收到选蛋后递无芝士蛋三明治并问袋；A第2步先答有芝士，B第3步选蛋，D第5步自带盒，E第6步装盒。

questions.prompt: What position does line B take?
questions.explanation: D第5步No回答要袋否并给自带盒；A第2步芝士答，B第3步选蛋，C第4步才问袋，E第6步应装盒。

questions.prompt: What position does line C take?
questions.explanation: A第2步回应Does cheese并问要否无芝士；B第3步答Yes选蛋，C第4步递食，D第5步袋答，E第6步装盒。

questions.prompt: What position does line D take?
questions.explanation: E第6步得知lunch box后说装入；A/B/C/D第2至5分别是芝士、选择、递食问袋、盒答，不能提前指盒。

questions.prompt: What position does line E take?
questions.explanation: B第3步Yes回答需无芝士并选蛋；A第2步应先问需否，C第4步给，D第5步袋答，E第6步装盒。

units.title: 展品打包前的核对词库

materials.title: Display Packing Bank 035B
materials.text:
Read the whole passage and use each bank word once. Bank: A. inside B. before C. compare D. dry E. carefully
We ____1____ the packing list with the objects on the table. Each object goes ____2____ its own labelled box. The boxes must stay ____3____ because the models are paper. We carry them ____4____ so no loose part falls off. The teacher checks the lids ____5____ we load the boxes into the trolley.

questions.prompt: Which word completes gap 1?
questions.explanation: C compare list with objects对照；A inside、B before介词，D dry状态、E carefully副词不作所需核对谓语。

questions.prompt: Which word completes gap 2?
questions.explanation: A inside box表箱内；B before时间不表装箱位置，C compare动词、D dry形容词、E carefully副词不接所需空间。

questions.prompt: Which word completes gap 3?
questions.explanation: D stay dry防纸模型受湿；A inside不是给定防湿状态，B before、C compare、E carefully不作干燥表语。

questions.prompt: Which word completes gap 4?
questions.explanation: E carefully小心搬防零件落；A inside表位置而该句强调搬运方式，B before、C compare、D dry不表达所需小心动作。

questions.prompt: Which word completes gap 5?
questions.explanation: B before先查盖后装车；A inside不连接完整时句，C compare、D dry、E carefully不表该先后。

units.title: 方向、乐器与照护的词语

materials.title: Ordinary Word Functions 035B
materials.text: Choose the word that matches the exact description.

questions.prompt: Which tool helps someone check directions such as north and south?
questions.explanation: A compass指南针指方向；B勺、C枕不测方向。

questions.prompt: Which instrument is played by blowing air across or into it?
questions.explanation: B flute长笛吹气奏；A鼓敲击，C小提琴拉弦，非所述吹奏。

questions.prompt: Which word names the usual first main meal in the morning?
questions.explanation: C breakfast早餐；A晚餐、B午夜时间不答晨间正餐。

questions.prompt: Which word describes a container with nothing in it?
questions.explanation: A empty空；B拥挤有许多，C礼貌形容行为不表示空容器。

questions.prompt: Which person’s work includes caring for patients?
questions.explanation: B nurse护士照护病人；A飞行员、C面包师工作不同。

units.title: 游戏卡不再只靠颜色区分

materials.title: Game Card Patterns Six Cloze 035B
materials.text:
Read the complete passage and choose a word for each numbered gap.
Our team cards were marked only by ____1____. In the dim hall, Jay found the red and green cards ____2____ to tell apart. We did not tell him to guess faster. We added simple ____3____: stripes on one set and dots on the other. We kept ____4____ the colours and the patterns, so players could use more than one clue. Before the next game, we ____5____ with Jay and another pupil that the cards were easy to sort. Then we wrote the new rule ____6____ where every team could read it.

questions.prompt: Which word completes gap 1?
questions.explanation: A red/green说明原按colour；B价格、C味道非游戏队卡标识。

questions.prompt: Which word completes gap 2?
questions.explanation: B dim hall里难分tell apart；A睡、C木制不描述辨别困难。

questions.prompt: Which word completes gap 3?
questions.explanation: C stripes dots均patterns图案；A食谱、B梯非所述标记类型。

questions.prompt: Which word completes gap 4?
questions.explanation: A both colours and patterns保留双线索；B neither需nor且删两者，C no不接the此结构。

questions.prompt: Which word completes gap 5?
questions.explanation: B checked with实际玩家核易分；A煮、C游不验证卡片辨认。

questions.prompt: Which word completes gap 6?
questions.explanation: C clearly清晰写供各队读；A饿、B圆不表达所需书写方式。

units.title: 背包里不必一起出门的东西

materials.title: Heavy Backpack Story 035B
materials.text:
Before a short hill walk, Dima filled his backpack with things he loved: a thick comic, a model car, a holiday stone and a drawing folder. There was little space left for water and a raincoat. He did not want to leave anything behind because each object reminded him of a good day.
His grandma did not tell him the objects were useless. She asked what the walk required and where the other objects could wait safely. Dima put the model and folder on his shelf, with a note to finish his drawing later. He kept the small stone in one pocket. With water and a raincoat packed, the bag was still lighter than before. On the hill, he was glad he could walk comfortably. Choosing for one journey had not meant giving up everything he cared about.

questions.prompt: Why is Dima’s bag heavy at first?
options: Grandma has filled it with tools.
The raincoat is made of stone.
questions.explanation: B装喜爱漫画车石画夹；A非只有水，C非祖母装，D雨衣材质无此。

questions.prompt: What practical items have little room initially?
questions.explanation: C原文water raincoat空间少；A/B/D非所需出行物。

questions.prompt: How does Grandma help?
options: Ask about the walk’s needs and safe places for other things.
Demand he throw away his memories.
questions.explanation: A问需求与留置处；B明确不贬无用；C不丢记忆；D未全包。

questions.prompt: What does Dima keep from the treasured objects?
options: A small stone in a pocket.
questions.explanation: D留小石；A整架、B全车、C全无均不符。

questions.prompt: What does Dima learn?
options: Every journey requires all his possessions.
Choosing for a purpose can preserve care without carrying everything.
Lighter bags always mean losing all memories.
Water is less useful than a model car on every walk.
questions.explanation: B为本次选择不等于弃爱物；A/C/D绝对化反文。

units.title: 周末活动记录的词形

materials.title: Weekend Report Forms 035B
materials.text:
Complete all five gaps using the correct one-word form of each given word.
1. Last night, I ____1____ (sleep) early before the long trip.
2. We brought two ripe ____2____ (mango) for the fruit display.
3. The reading corner is ____3____ (quiet) than the busy courtyard.
4. Look! The helper is ____4____ (study) the route map before leading us.
5. The actor shouted the line ____5____ (angry; use the conventional adverb ending in -ly).

questions.prompt: Gap 1: use SLEEP.
questions.explanation: 接受slept：Last night过去，sleep不规则；sleep原形、sleeped错、sleeping分词不作过去谓语。

questions.prompt: Gap 2: use MANGO.
questions.explanation: 接受mangoes及mangos两种常见标准复数；two排除单数mango，mangoeses重复复数，mango’s所有格不作本句数目后复数。

questions.prompt: Gap 3: use QUIET.
questions.explanation: 接受quieter：than比较安静程度；quiet原级、quietest最高级、quietness名词不合比较表语。

questions.prompt: Gap 4: use STUDY.
questions.explanation: 接受studying：is进行，study保留y加ing；study原形、studing错拼、studied过去式不合正在研看。

questions.prompt: Gap 5: write the conventional adverb ending in -ly from ANGRY.
questions.explanation: 接受angrily：本空明确要求ANGRY常规-ly副词。angry、angrier、anger不满足本题形态要求；并非据此宣称其他语境中的情绪、比较或名词用法非法，未列复核。

units.title: 和朋友交流时说清楚边界与需要

materials.title: Friendship Speaking Functions 035B
materials.text: Choose the sentence that directly achieves each speaker’s stated purpose. Other options are possible remarks but serve different purposes.

questions.prompt: A friend’s jokes about you feel uncomfortable, and you want them to stop. What should you say?
options: Could you stop making jokes about me? I do not find them funny.
Could we choose a different meeting time?
What game shall we play next?
questions.explanation: A清楚表达玩笑边界与感受；B改时、C下个游戏不请求停止该行为。

questions.prompt: The group walks faster than you can manage, and you want a slower pace. What should you say?
options: Where is the final meeting point?
Could we slow down a little so I can keep up?
questions.explanation: B请求降速度说明跟队需要；A终点、C地图持有人不直接调步速。

questions.prompt: You forgot an item you promised to return and want to apologise with a clear plan. What should you say?
options: What colour would you like next time?
I am sorry I forgot it. May I bring it tomorrow morning?
questions.explanation: C认忘并提明确归还时间；A颜色、B换书题不道歉补救。

questions.prompt: You want feedback on personal writing but prefer a private conversation. What should you ask?
options: Could we discuss my draft privately when you have time?
Could you announce my whole draft to the group?
How many pages are on the table?
questions.explanation: A请求私下择时谈稿；B公开宣读相反；C页数不安排反馈形式。

questions.prompt: A friend looks upset, and you want to ask rather than assume the cause. What should you say?
options: You must be angry about the game.
Would you like to tell me what happened?
questions.explanation: B开放邀请自述原因；A预设原因与目的相反；C选饭不询当下经过。
